presets.notes: Versioned corpus preset for the legume nodulation vocabulary. Reproducibility: the fetch records the UniProt release and a per-table sha256 in the fetch manifest, and the build records corpus_sha256 / excluded_sha256 / coverage_sha256 in the corpus manifest. NCBI taxon ids 3702/3880/34305 verified against NCBI Taxonomy (eutils esummary, 2026-08-11). Proteome UP ids are not recorded here: this repository has no primary source for them (to be confirmed). Required terms are all present as reviewed UniProt gene_primary values in Medicago; the optional terms are mostly unreviewed or named differently, so they are recorded rather than gated. Governance: the acceptance terms are drawn from the public nodulation gene vocabulary (literature/UniProt nomenclature), not derived from any benchmark truth or benchmark case.
